task.question: A reversible source-loader on three little-endian bits is defined by the rule that maps each slot value s in {0,...,7} to (s XOR 3) mod 8, i.e. it flips the two low-order bits of s. Prove that this loader is its own inverse (an involution) as a permutation of {0,...,7}, and give the explicit image list obtained by applying it to 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 in order. Explain why the involution property is exactly what lets the two bit-flip gates that realize it also undo it when applied a second time.
assumptions: Slot values range over {0,...,7}, so the outer mod 8 never fires
The loader is XOR with the fixed mask 3
conventions: XOR with a constant mask toggles exactly the bits set in the mask
The loader is realized by two X gates on the two low wires

Assess and refute that request for the actual source compiler if it omits the program's stored phase; do not redefine the inherited bare C or silently quotient by physical global phase. A PrimitiveProgram consists of its primitive list and an exact globalPhase phi, with full denotation D=exp(i phi) C. Explain refinement versus definition and which full-space/basis-action, physical-global-phase and cost/cleanup conclusions follow or remain separate.
assumptions: The reversible program induces a bijection of basis strings
The compiled matrix is the ordered product of emitted primitive-gate matrices
conventions: The permutation matrix sends column c to the single row E(c)
Compilation is a separate pipeline from the combinatorial bijection

task.question: A fixed indicator oracle and its stated dagger are certified for a warm Robin instance by four facts bundled together: the dagger's matrix equals the oracle's own matrix; the integer image map of the oracle is self-inverse; and the oracle matrix is a permutation (each row has a unique column with a 1, and each column a unique row). From these, explain the precise sense in which this indicator oracle is self-inverse, why 'dagger equals itself' plus 'image map self-inverse' together certify a clean uncompute, and what would break the uncompute if only the permutation property held without the self-inverse image.
assumptions: The dagger is stored as the same matrix as the oracle
The oracle's integer image map is asserted self-inverse
conventions: A permutation matrix P is unitary with P-dagger = P^{-1}
